idea.title: The photo dump is killing your listing
idea.angle: Twenty photos with the gate or a blurry corridor first tells buyers nothing. Buyers decide in about a second, so the first photo must earn the next swipe.
idea.hook: STOP DUMPING 20 PHOTOS IN RANDOM ORDER

slides.heading: BUYERS DECIDE IN ABOUT A **SECOND**
slides.body: Lead with the gate or a blurry corridor and they scroll past.

slides.heading: **HERO** SHOT FIRST
slides.body: Your single most impressive shot. Even if it's not the front.

slides.heading: THEN THE **MAIN** ROOMS
slides.body: Living room, kitchen, master bedroom, master bathroom, then other bedrooms.

slides.heading: END WITH THE **EXTRAS**
slides.body: Your standout feature, like a pool or view. Then the neighbourhood.

slides.heading: SAME PHOTOS. **NEW** ORDER.
slides.body:
Before: 20 photos. Gate first. Blurry corridor next.
After:
✓ Hero shot first
✓ Main rooms in order
✓ Standout feature
✓ Neighbourhood last

caption:
Twenty random photos don't sell a home. The right order does.

Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking.
Lead with your best shot, not the gate.
Then walk them through the home: main rooms, standout feature, neighbourhood.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
